```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
```

```{r}
# Folder containing the raw TRA exports.
folder <- "data-raw/tourism/tra-raw"

# Final output file.
output_file <- file.path(folder, "reason_all_polished.csv")

# Only pick the quarterly "reason-" exports.
reason_files <- dir_ls(folder, glob = file.path(folder, "*.csv")) %>%
  keep(~ str_detect(path_file(.x), "^reason-[0-9]{4}-q[1-4]\\.csv$"))

if (length(reason_files) == 0) {
  stop("No reason CSV files found in: ", folder)
}

expected_output_cols <- c(
  "year",
  "month",
  "address",
  "stop_reason",
  "trips",
  "n_sample"
)

standardise_month <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(str_to_title(as.character(x)))
  x <- na_if(x, "")

  # Handle numeric months as well as names/abbreviations.
  month_map <- tibble(
    raw = c(as.character(1:12), base::month.abb, base::month.name),
    month = c(base::month.name, base::month.name, base::month.name)
  )

  out <- month_map$month[match(x, month_map$raw)]
  out <- coalesce(out, x)

  # Normalise common variations such as "Sept".
  out <- if_else(out == "Sept", "September", out)
  out
}

read_reason_file <- function(file_path) {
  message("Reading: ", basename(file_path))

  lines <- tryCatch(
    read_lines(file_path, progress = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Could not read file: ", basename(file_path), " | ", conditionMessage(e))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(lines)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  header_row <- which(
    str_detect(
      lines,
      '^"?Calendar year"?,"?Month returned from trip"?,"?State"?,"?Stopover reason"?'
    )
  )[1]

  if (is.na(header_row)) {
    warning("Could not find the table header in: ", basename(file_path))
    return(NULL)
  }

  header_line <- paste(lines[max(1, header_row - 1):header_row], collapse = " ")
  expected_header_labels <- c(
    "Calendar year",
    "Month returned from trip",
    "State",
    "Stopover reason",
    "Overnight trips (000)",
    "Sample"
  )
  missing_header_labels <- expected_header_labels[
    !map_lgl(expected_header_labels, ~ str_detect(header_line, fixed(.x)))
  ]

  if (length(missing_header_labels) > 0) {
    warning(
      "Header in ",
      basename(file_path),
      " is missing expected labels: ",
      paste(missing_header_labels, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  footer_row <- which(
    str_detect(lines, fixed("(c) Tourism Research Australia")) |
      str_detect(lines, fixed("Tourism Research Australia"))
  )[1]

  data_start <- header_row + 1
  data_end <- if (is.na(footer_row)) length(lines) else footer_row - 1

  if (data_start > data_end) {
    warning("No data rows found after the header in: ", basename(file_path))
    return(NULL)
  }

  data_block <- lines[data_start:data_end]

  dat <- tryCatch(
    read_csv(
      I(paste(data_block, collapse = "\n")),
      col_names = FALSE,
      col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
      na = c("", "NA"),
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      progress = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Could not parse data rows in: ",
        basename(file_path),
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(dat)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Ensure we have at least six columns to work with.
  if (ncol(dat) < 6) {
    warning(
      "Expected at least 6 columns in: ",
      basename(file_path),
      " but found ",
      ncol(dat),
      ". Missing columns will be filled with NA."
    )
    missing_cols <- 6 - ncol(dat)
    dat[paste0("extra_", seq_len(missing_cols))] <- NA_character_
  }

  dat <- dat[, seq_len(max(6, ncol(dat)))]
  names(dat) <- c("year", "month", "address", "stop_reason", "trips", "n_sample", paste0("extra_", seq_len(max(0, ncol(dat) - 6))))
  dat <- dat[, expected_output_cols]

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(str_squish(as.character(.x)), ""))) %>%
    fill(year, month, address, .direction = "down") %>%
    filter(
      coalesce(str_to_lower(year), "") != "total",
      coalesce(str_to_lower(month), "") != "total",
      coalesce(str_to_lower(address), "") != "total",
      coalesce(str_to_lower(stop_reason), "") != "total"
    ) %>%
    filter(!if_all(everything(), is.na))

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    warning("No usable data rows remained after cleaning: ", basename(file_path))
    return(NULL)
  }

  dat %>%
    transmute(
      year = as.integer(parse_number(year)),
      month = standardise_month(month),
      address = as.integer(parse_number(address)),
      stop_reason = as.integer(parse_number(stop_reason)),
      trips = parse_number(trips),
      n_sample = as.integer(parse_number(n_sample)),
      source_file = basename(file_path)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), !is.na(address), !is.na(stop_reason))
}

reason_list <- map(reason_files, read_reason_file)

failed_files <- reason_files[map_lgl(reason_list, is.null)]
if (length(failed_files) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Some files could not be parsed and were skipped: ",
    paste(basename(failed_files), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

reason_all <- reason_list %>%
  compact() %>%
  bind_rows()

reason_clean <- reason_all %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(.data[["month"]], levels = base::month.name, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month, address, stop_reason) %>%
  select(all_of(expected_output_cols))

# filter dataset just only tourism region data
tourism_region <- readRDS("data-raw/tourism/tourism_region.rds") 
filtered_reason_clean <- reason_clean |> 
  filter(address %in% tourism_region$sa2_code_tra) |> 
  rename(sa2_code_tra = address)

file_tourism_reason_raw <- "data-raw/tourism/tra-raw/tourism_reason_raw.csv"
write_csv(reason_clean, file_tourism_reason_raw, na = "")

file_tourism_reason <- "data-raw/tourism/tra-raw/tourism_reason.csv"
write_csv(filtered_reason_clean, file_tourism_reason, na = "")

# Helpful checks
glimpse(filtered_reason_clean)
head(filtered_reason_clean)
count(filtered_reason_clean, year, month, name = "rows") %>%
  arrange(year, month) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

If we want to know sa2_code_tra names we can use the tourism_region dataset that we read in earlier. The `tourism_region` dataset contains the mapping of `sa2_code_tra` to their corresponding names. You can view the names by selecting the relevant columns from the `tourism_region` dataset.



```{r}
stop_reason_names <-  read.csv("data-raw/tourism/tra-raw/stop_reason_names.csv")
tourism_reason <- read.csv("data-raw/tourism/tra-raw/tourism_reason.csv")

# select only first layer
l1_stop_reason_names <- stop_reason_names %>%
  filter(l1_group > 0) %>%
  select(stop_reason, name)

l2_stop_reason_names <- stop_reason_names %>%
  filter(l2_group > 9) %>%
  select(stop_reason, name)

# extract data from tourism_reason for l1 stop reason
tourism_reason %>%
  filter(stop_reason %in% l1_stop_reason_names$stop_reason) %>%
  left_join(l1_stop_reason_names, by = "stop_reason") %>%
  group_by(year, stop_reason, name) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE)*1000, n_sample = sum(n_sample, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```


```{r}
tourism_reason <- read.csv("data-raw/tourism/tra-raw/tourism_reason.csv")
tourism_region <- readRDS("data-raw/tourism/tourism_region.rds")

# convert sa2_code_tra to integer in tourism_region
tourism_region <- tourism_region %>%
  mutate(sa2_code_tra = as.integer(sa2_code_tra))

# find total of trips for each region
tourism_region %>%
  left_join(tourism_reason, by = "sa2_code_tra") %>%
  group_by(state, region, ws_id, sa2_code_tra) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE)*1000, 
  n_sample = sum(n_sample, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```
